objectives: Separate the Reporting role from administration
Pick the category that matches the question
paragraphs: Standard reports do not appear because you are an administrator. The community reporting article says you need the Reporting role and at least one reporting permission.

lessons.title: Layouts, and the matrix that will not export
objectives: Match the layout to the question
Do not call a matrix a CSV
paragraphs: The same reporting guidance describes three layouts: Tabular, Summary, and Matrix. A matrix answers a cross-tab question. It is not the layout you hand to a spreadsheet as a direct CSV.
Pick the layout from the question. 'Every call' wants tabular. 'Averages by skill' wants summary. 'Skill by disposition' might want a matrix, and then a second export if someone needs rows.

lessons.title: The call log is a window, not an archive
objectives: Separate the call log window from audio retention
Date the article you are quoting
paragraphs: The call log report is the place people look for one call. The community article on filters, dated 14 July 2026, describes a window of about 60 days unless retention has been extended.

Data-retention terms are a different clock: VCC audio is the sooner of 30 days, a successful SFTP or FTP offload, or the contract. A report row and a recording file do not expire on the same day. Say which one you mean.

lessons.title: Call variables are not history
objectives: Enable reporting before you need the column
Check custom dispositions one by one
paragraphs: Call variables can be reported when two things are true: the user has permission to edit them, and the variable is enabled for reporting. The community article is explicit that they are not historical. Turn the flag on today and yesterday's calls stay empty.
Apply to All Dispositions does not cover custom dispositions. If the variable should stick on a custom outcome, that disposition is a separate checkbox, not a wish.

lessons.title: Prebuilt UC and the connector that is not an adapter
objectives: Name prebuilt UC separately from the desktop app
Budget about 320 kbps when the UC client runs locally
paragraphs: The product material names prebuilt connections for Zoom Phone and Microsoft Teams. A prebuilt path is a product. A Web Connector that opens a URL is also a product. They are not the bandwidth line you add for a Teams client on the agent's PC.

The technical requirements treat a Teams, Zoom, Office@Hand, RingCentral, or Nextiva client on the workstation as about 320 kbps of extra traffic. Integrating the UC platform and running its app are two designs.

lessons.title: What an extract is allowed to remember
objectives: Export before the clocks run out
Keep DID retention separate from domain retention
paragraphs: Reporting Web Services can move numbers out of the domain. Retention still applies to what Five9 keeps, not to the warehouse you built. Once a row is in your bucket, your policy owns it.

Disabled domains, campaign state, agent data, and numbers have their own retention lines: agent data 60 days, campaign state 120 days, a disabled domain 120 days after closure, DIDs and toll-free numbers 90 days after closure. Do not design a 'temporary' domain and expect the DIDs to wait forever.
